entities.summary: Stepan Putilo (b. 1998-07-27, Minsk) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Minsk and Belarus. Known in the fields of belarus, composers & musicians, europe.
